summary: Describes the process of cancelling a fee receipt and where the cancelled transactions are reported.
navigation: Fees > Fee Transaction List > (select transaction) > Cancel
steps: Select the receipt to be cancelled.
Provide a remark explaining the reason for cancellation.
business_rules: Cancelled receipts will appear in the "Cancellation Report" and can be filtered by "status: cancel" in other reports.
important_notes: A remark is required when cancelling a receipt.
questions: How do I cancel a fee receipt?
Where can I find cancelled fee receipts?
What information is required when cancelling a receipt?
